purpose: Safely manage GitHub repository resources across read-only and high-impact operations.

trigger: Inspect settings and branch rules for my GitHub repository
Create a private repository under my authorized organization
Prepare a release for my repository after checks pass
do_not_trigger: Leave a line comment on a pull request
Install a Python package into the host

preflight: Pin owner namespace and the exact repository before interacting.
Verify acting identity, current settings, required rulesets and backup scope.
Separate read-only inspection, remote mutation and critical admin privileges.
workflow: Prepare an exact action preview and owner authorization for remote writes.
Call only the scoped provider tool with authorization and retry budget.
Read back new settings or resource ID and record any unknown result.

evidence.how_to_verify: Confirm exact repository owner/name, default branch and permissions.
Verify exact local worktree and cloned HEAD without overwriting files.
Read back created repository ID, visibility and owner.
Confirm exact critical settings, workflow or secret operation.
Read back critical setting or workflow state after the approved change.

failure_modes: No credential scraping or secret literal in shell commands.
On unknown admin write, reconcile provider state before any retry.
